sources.description: DevSecOps global market report: $3.73B in 2021 → $9.06B in 2025 → $11.61B in 2026, growing at 28.1% CAGR toward $27.12B by 2030
Application security market at $10.6B in 2025, projected to reach $42.1B by 2033 at 18.8% CAGR; North America holds 39.4% share
Socket raises $60M Series C at $1B valuation led by Thrive Capital with a16z (May 2026); 300% YoY revenue growth; $125M total raised; protects 27,000+ organizations
Endor Labs forks Semgrep into open-source Opengrep with 7 ecosystem partners; Endor raised $93M Series B April 2025 led by DFJ Growth
Supply chain attacks statistics: third-party breaches doubled from 15% to 30%; average breach cost $4.91M; 267 days mean-time-to-detect (citing IBM Cost of Data Breach 2025 and Verizon DBIR)
GitHub Advanced Security unbundled April 2025; CodeQL runs 10B scans monthly; 15M+ vulnerabilities resolved; 92% of Fortune 100 use GitHub Enterprise
EU Cyber Resilience Act official page: enters into force December 2024; active-exploitation reporting obligations live 11 September 2026; fines up to €15M or 2.5% of global turnover
Gartner Application Security Strategy 2026: 43% of organisations at lowest AppSec maturity; AI, developer experience, and tool consolidation are the three structural shifts
